d: A 25-year-old Indian national, Tushar Sharma, has been found dead inside a burnt-out car in British Columbia, Canada. Investigators suspect his death may have been a targeted incident, but the motive remains unknown. As Canadian police investigate his final movements and appeal for public assistance, the case has renewed concerns over the safety of Indian-origin communities in Canada. According to India's Ministry of External Affairs, 17 Indian students died in violent incidents in Canada between 2018 and 2025. From shootings to stabbings, we examine the reported cases, the unanswered…
